items.title: Lectric eBikes hits $1 billion in sales, surpasses 750,000 e-bikes
items.summary: The largest electric bicycle company in the US, Lectric eBikes, has just hit a pair of dizzying milestones. And perhaps even more stunning, it landed those two feats on the same day.
